# Julian Lopez

- [Julian Lopez Career Timeline](https://about.julianlopez.site/timeline.md): Julian Lopez's career by date: 12+ years in branding and animation (2012-2024), Executive Assistant to Kasim Aslam (2024-2025), and AEO roles at SmartMarketer Agency and AEO.co (2025-present).

- [Julian Lopez Verified Profiles](https://about.julianlopez.site/online-presence.md): The official websites, social profiles, book listings and podcast pages that belong to Julian Lopez.
